book.name: Yohane
book.title: Malobhe gha Mbone ngita chighajhandikwe na Yohane

content: Yecho agholo magholo gha bhabholwa bhake

Likahighalike lichiko limo kujhimukila Unyagho gwa Pachaka. Yecho akamanyite chaa jhake jha kubhoka pannema pano nu kujhenda kwa Tate mundo lihikite. Akajhendilile kwapala bhando bhake pannema ghongo, akabhapahile kwa upalo gwangajhomoka.
Bhahe, Yecho na bhabholwa bhake pubhalalila kimiye. Limbembela akanyingii Yuda mwana gwa Simone Chikaliote na kumpela mawacho gha kunnyambila Yecho.
Yecho akamanyite kubhehe Tate mundo ankamwii ukindendeke gwa kila kilebhe, na akamanye ahumila kwa Chapanga na akamanye nakelebhuka kabhele kwa Chapanga.
Bhahe, Yecho ajhakubhoka pakiheneko, ajhakuhula ngobho jha panja jhake, kutabha nkunge pakibhuno.
Peniya ajhakubheka mache mkambo na kutumbuu kwagholola bhabholwa bhake magholo na kwahungulila kwa ngobho jhakungite nkunge jhela.
Bhahe, Yecho pahikita kwa Simone Petile, Petile ajhakunnkonya, “Bhambo, bho, mwenga migholola magholo ghango?”
Yecho panyangwila, “Ngoheno naumanyiijhe chinihenga, nambo palonge nabangatuka.”
Petile ajhakunnobholela, “Mbahijhe mangang'olole jhe magholo ghango!” Yecho panyangwila. “Anda nkanikiye kungholola magholo ghino namme ndeka mabholwa bhango.”
Simone Petile ajhakunnobholela, “Bhambo, nkotoka kugholola magholo ghango tugha helahela ung'olola mabhoko na muto gwango!”
Yecho panyangwila, “Mundo jwajhoghite njwe yegha jhoha abhii nyahinyahi ipalwa jhe kugholola magholo, mangota mmii nyahinyahi nambo mabhoha ndeka.”
Yecho akaumanye jwapala kunnyambila jhola, ndi nhwalo alongila yenio, “Mangota mmii nyahinyahi nambo mabhoha ndeka.”
Yecho pajhomolila kwagholola magholo, ajhakuhwala ngobho na kubhujha kabhele pakatamite. Ajhakwakonya, “Bho, umanye ghunitendile?”
“Mangota ungema nenga mmola na Bhambo, na mwitenda chamaha, nhwalo ndi chimile.
Nenga Mmola na Bhambo gwino, ning'olwile mangota magholo ghino, na mangota helahela nng'ololane magholo mabhene.
Nenga ninangiye nnandanikiho mangota, na mangota ntende yenio ngita chinitendi nenga.
Ninnobholela chakaka, mmanda ahoto ndeka kubhehe munahota, hilu mundo jwatumwa chi nkolongwa kuliku jhola jwantumita.
Bhahe, nhwalo mughamanye gheniya, Chapanga annombe kwa kuhenga gheniya!
“Ghunilonge ghano chi ghoha ghino mabhoha, namanyite bhala bhinahaghwile. Nambo Majhandiko gha Chapanga ghatimile ghighalongela, ‘Mundo jhola jhunilye nako kiheneko chimo ndi jwapala kunnyambila.’
Nenga ninnobholela kabula jha kupitila palonge, kupala pughapala kutendeka mbala umanye na nnyeketela kubhehe ‘Nenga ndi Jhumile.’
Ninnobholela chakaka, mundo jwampokela jhola jhunituma, jwenio ambokii nenga helahela, na mundo jwamboke nenga, ampokii jhola jwandumita.”
Yecho ilota mundo natendwa kujhambilwa
Yecho pajhomolila kulonge malobhe gheniya, ajhakubhehe ngolongondi ku mwojho gwake na ajhakwalobholela, “Ninnobholela chakaka, jhumo pakate jhino nandenda kunyambila.”
Bhabholwa bhake bhajhakulolehana kumiho, nambo bhakamanyite jhe annonge ghane.
Jhumo jwa bhabholwa bhake, jwakapahilwe na Yecho akatamite pahina jha Yecho.
Bhahe, Simone Petile ajhakunkinyulila jhola mmola nnyake na kulonge, “Munkonye annonge ghane.”
Mmolwa jwenio ajhakuheghelela pahina na Yecho, ajhakunkonya, “Bhambo, minnonge ghane?”

Yecho ajhakwajhanguu, “Mundo jhola jhunipala kunyakiya libumunda linichwiya mubakule ndi jhojho.” Bhahe, Yecho ajhakutola kimbembela cha libumunda na kuchwiya mubakule na kumpekeya Yuda mwana gwa Simone Ichikaliote.
Papalapala Yuda papokila tugha kimbembela chela cha libumunda, Limbembela lijhakunyingila. Bhahe, Yecho ajhakunnobholela, “Nhwenga kajhombe chipala kuhenga!”
Nambo akibha jhe hilu jhumo pakate jha bhala bhubhakibha pakiheneko jwakamanyite nhwalo gwa nike Yecho akannobholi naha.
Nhwalo Yuda akibha abhekita kihukilo cha mbijha, bhabholwa bhange bhahambwika Yecho anobholile akahemele ilebhe ya unyagho gwa Pachaka amu kwabhaghanichila akahocho ilebhe.
Papalapala Yuda papokila tugha kimbembela chela cha libumunda, ajhakupita panja. Ikibha kilo.
Lilaghalikilo liyono
Yuda papitita panja, Yecho palongila, “Ngoheno Mwana gwa Mundo alombitwe, na jwenio Chapanga alombitwe kupetela jwenio.
Anda Chapanga alombwite nkate jha Mwana gwa Mundo, na Chapanga helahela nanomba Mwana gwa Mundo nkate jhake na jwenio nannomba changakiyoto.
Yana yango, nandama na mangota kwa machiko ghandina. Mangota naundenda kumbalaha, nambo ngoheno ninnobholela chela chinalobholila bhakolo bha Akayahude, ‘Kunijhenda mwihoto jhe kuhika.’
Ngoheno nimpela lilaghano liyono, mpalane mabhene kwa mabhene. Ngita chinipala nenga na mangota helahela mpalane.
Anda mpaline, bhando bhoha nabhamanya mangota ndi bhabholwa bhango.”
Yecho ilota Petile nakanila
Simone Petile ajhakunkonya, “Bhambo, kojhe kumijhenda?” Yecho ajhakujhanguu, “Kunijhenda mihoto ndeka kungengama ngoheno nambo naungengama panyuma jhango.”
Petile ajhakunnobholela kabhele, “Bhambo, nakilimba nike kunkengama ngoheno?, Nenga nnyeketile kuwegha kwa nhwalo gwino!”
Yecho pajhangwila, “Bho, mwenga naunhwa kwa nhwalo jha nenga? Ninnobholela chakaka, naunganila patato lijhogholo nakubheka jhe.”
